title: About
text:
About me: My name is Barry and I just finished my Bachelors of Science in Biology here at UBC. I was born and raised in Vancouver, so I have been here basically all my life. I am hoping to get both foundational and technical data science skills from this program, and to allow me to utilize it within the context of biology (industry, research, etc.).
